overview: This item sets up the jido_hub Phoenix project that will serve as a web interface for interacting with Jido agents. The focus is on establishing a clean project structure, initial configuration, and dependencies that align with existing Jido components and the jido_messaging layer. This includes setting up basic routing, a minimal landing layout, and any required configuration for environment-based settings, security headers, and development tooling. The deliverable is a new Phoenix application (or umbrella app component) with a documented setup process, including how to run it in development and how it connects to local or remote Jido agents. It should be ready to host a chat UI and any supporting pages, with sensible defaults for logging, error pages, and asset compilation. The project should include placeholder modules or contexts where future chat-related logic and integrations will live.
title: Phoenix project setup
